sources.title: RoomPlan overview
sources.supported_fact: RoomPlan uses camera/LiDAR inputs and exposes parametric room output; it permits customized capture UI.

sources.title: WWDC23: Explore enhancements to RoomPlan
sources.supported_fact: Historical guidance on continuous sessions, MultiRoom and residential capture size. The 2023 guidance is not a universal current hard limit.

sources.title: StructureBuilder.capturedStructure(from:)
sources.supported_fact: Rooms require compatible world space; persistent ARSession or successful world-map relocalization supports alignment.

sources.title: Scanning the rooms of a single structure
sources.supported_fact: Room-by-room capture, guidance, and keeping the AR session alive between compatible scans.

sources.title: CapturedRoom.Surface.polygonCorners
sources.supported_fact: Polygon corner data is in local plane coordinates and represents nonuniform walls/floors.

sources.title: CapturedRoom.Confidence
sources.supported_fact: Confidence denotes certainty of feature classification; it is not a survey accuracy certificate.

sources.title: ARDepthData.confidenceMap
sources.supported_fact: Depth confidence is a different signal; reflective/absorbing surfaces can reduce confidence.

sources.title: CapturedRoom.Surface.Curve
sources.supported_fact: Curved-surface metadata includes angles, radius and local center.

sources.title: Bringing SceneKit projects to RealityKit
sources.supported_fact: Apple describes SceneKit as soft-deprecated and recommends a newer native framework such as RealityKit for long-term work.

sources.title: ProcessInfo thermal state
sources.supported_fact: Thermal states include nominal, fair, serious and critical.

sources.title: UI Design Dos and Don'ts
sources.supported_fact: Guidance includes at least 44-by-44-point hit targets, readable content and clear alignment.

sources.title: Complete file protection
sources.supported_fact: Protected files cannot be read/written while locked; the app must handle unavailable protected data.

sources.title: RoomCaptureView init(frame:arSession:)
sources.supported_fact: A custom world-tracking session can be used and its configuration preserved.

sources.title: StructureBuilder.ConfigurationOptions
sources.supported_fact: Current symbol reference uses init(options:), unlike some historical presentation code.

sources.title: UnlitMaterial
sources.supported_fact: A material not responding to scene lighting; translucent output requires explicit blending configuration.

sources.title: RoomBuilder.init(options:)
sources.supported_fact: RoomBuilder accepts an explicit configuration option set.

sources.title: Resumable uploads
sources.supported_fact: TUS resumable upload support. Native implementation and background-transfer behavior still need validation.

sources.title: Row level security
sources.supported_fact: Server-side access rules and key handling are necessary; authentication alone is not per-project authorization.

sources.title: Database backups
sources.supported_fact: Database backups do not include actual Storage object contents.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.supported_fact: Reviewed current change index before integration planning. No Supabase SDK/schema/server is deployed here.

sources.title: AuxiliumOS ADR-001 at observed newer PR head
sources.supported_fact: OS/Moldo ownership, scoped integration and exact-version rules. Read via connected GitHub. This is architectural context, not proof of deployed integration.
